FUEL_ERR_MONEY: You do not have enough money
FUEL_ERR_NO_VEHICLE: Sit in the driver seat to refuel
ADMIN_TAB_STATIONS_DESC: Where players refuel and what it costs.
ADMIN_C_STATION_DESC: Players drive inside the area and press the interaction key to fill the tank.
ADMIN_H_COORDS: Stand in the middle of the pumps and use your position.
ADMIN_H_RADIUS: How far from the centre a vehicle can refuel.
ADMIN_H_PRICE: Dollars per percent of a tank (a full fill from empty costs 100 times this).
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: How fast vehicles use fuel and how refuelling is paid.
ADMIN_C_FUEL_DESC: Vehicles burn more at high revs; bicycles and electric cars burn nothing.
ADMIN_H_CONSUMPTION: 1 is normal (a full tank lasts about 25 minutes of driving), 2 burns twice as fast, 0 turns fuel off.
